info.title: SJewls Customer Mobile API
info.description: Complete API specification for the SJewls Customer Mobile Application — Customer Authentication & OTP Verification (SMSlenz.lk HTTP API at https://smslenz.lk/api/send-sms with +94 normalization; Gmail API HTTPS REST via Google OAuth2 with fallback to SMTP port 587), Profile Completion, Self-Service Account Closure, Active Store Branches, Jewellery Plan & Category Browsing, Plan Enrolment Previews & Creation, Contribution Ledger, Gold Rate & Payment Quotes, Deferred Payment Initiation, Customer Notifications, and Persistent Plan Alerts (Chitu Raffle Winner & Jewellery Plan Completion popups/banners with acknowledgement).

get.description: Retrieves all currently active branches for customer registration, store location selection, and mobile lookups.

post.summary: Check if contact exists in database and determine next step (Login or Register)
post.description: Verifies the phone number or email address against existing customers in the database. Returns whether the customer exists, profile completion state, and recommended next action ('Login' or 'Register').

post.summary: Request verification OTP via Phone (SMSlenz.lk) or Email (Gmail API / SMTP)
post.description: Generates and dispatches a 6-digit verification code to the customer's phone (dispatched via SMSlenz.lk HTTP POST to https://smslenz.lk/api/send-sms with E.164 +94 normalization; Text.lk is preserved strictly for configuration-only rollback via Sms:Provider=TextLk with no automatic runtime fallback) or email address (dispatched via Gmail API HTTPS REST endpoint https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/messages/send with OAuth2 tokens, or SMTP port 587 STARTTLS via MailKit). Enforces rate-limiting and 5-minute expiry.

post.summary: Verify submitted OTP code and authenticate or continue registration
post.description:
Verifies the submitted 6-digit OTP against active challenges.

**Outcomes & Responses:**
• `200 OK (nextAction: 'Dashboard')`: Customer exists and profile is complete. Returns JWT access token, refresh token, and customer details.
• `200 OK (nextAction: 'CompleteProfile')`: Customer is new or profile is incomplete. Returns temporary 1-hour `registrationToken`.
• `400 Bad Request`: Verification code incorrect (attempts decremented, max 5 allowed), challenge expired (after 5 minutes), or challenge already consumed.
• `401 Unauthorized`: Customer account is deactivated or closed.

post.summary: Complete customer profile registration
post.description: Finalizes customer registration using the registrationToken. Automatically preserves the initially entered OTP-verified contact and saves any provided secondary email/phone number. Requires FullName, DateOfBirth (18+), and valid Sri Lankan NIC. Returns JWT access and refresh tokens.

post.summary: Exchange refresh token for a new access token
post.description: Rotates the refresh token and returns a new active access token.

post.summary: Revoke refresh token and log out
post.description: Revokes the specified refresh token, terminating the active mobile session.

get.description: Retrieves paginated Chitu plans open for joining or late-joining in the customer's registered branch.

parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 50).

get.summary: Get Chitu plan details with schedule and terms
get.description: Retrieves full details, round schedule, and terms for a specific Chitu plan.

post.summary: Preview initial payment for joining a Chitu plan
post.description: Calculates required initial payment covering Round 1 (pre-enrolment) or all elapsed rounds (late joining) for requested slot quantity.

post.summary: Confirm and join Chitu plan with slot purchase
post.description: Idempotently processes initial payment (or simulated payment in test mode) and assigns sequential permanent slots.

parameters.description: Optional client-generated UUID idempotency key to prevent duplicate enrolment creations across network retries.

post.description: Calculates per-slot oldest-unpaid-first allocations, resulting arrears, and raffle eligibility.

post.summary: Confirm and post payment for existing slots
post.description: Idempotently processes contribution payment, marks instalments as Paid, and updates slot coverage.

post.summary: Preview enrolment confirmation summary
post.description: Returns a proposed enrolment confirmation summary containing plan snapshot, target grams, premium percentage, proposed joining date and deadline.

post.summary: Confirm and join jewellery plan
post.description: Creates an active enrolment immediately without requiring an initial payment. Idempotent across retries with the same IdempotencyKey. Triggers an activation notification. Requires explicit confirmation if the customer has previously enrolled in this plan.

parameters.name: X-Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated UUID idempotency key to prevent duplicate enrolment creations across network retries.

get.description: Retrieves paginated jewellery plan enrolments for the authenticated customer, showing target grams, net accumulated gold, remaining grams, and contribution availability.

parameters.name: pageSize

get.description: Retrieves full details and progress metrics for a specific enrolment owned by the customer.
Retrieves the confirmed contribution and payment ledger history for this jewellery plan enrolment.
Retrieves the authoritative current gold rates (24K and 22K in LKR) for customer display and quote estimation. Reflects active store manual overrides or live market feeds.
Retrieves active jewellery categories for the customer's registered branch, including counts of currently available plans.
Returns currently available jewellery plans for a specific category. Plans whose admin start date is in the future are strictly excluded.
Retrieves active, currently available jewellery plans for the customer's branch, optionally filtered by category.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Optional category filter. When provided, returns only active plans belonging to this category.

get.description: Retrieves details of an individual plan including target gold grams, offered durations, and premium percentage.

post.summary: Preview gold payment calculation breakdown
post.description: Calculates an informational calculation preview for Buy Gram or Buy Amount mode without altering balances or creating a quote.

post.summary: Lock time-limited payment quote (Pay Now)
post.description: Locks an authoritative payment quote for 5 minutes at the latest applicable gold rate. Guarantees payable amount and credited grams during validity.

get.description: Retrieves the status, values, and expiry of a locked payment quote.

post.summary: Initiate payment for locked quote (Gateway Deferred)
post.description: Gateway integration is deferred. Returns PaymentProviderNotConfigured (HTTP 501). No fake checkout URL is generated, and balances remain unchanged.

get.description: Retrieves paginated notifications for the customer (such as jewellery plan activations and completions).

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 50).

post.summary: Mark notification as read
post.description: Marks an individual customer notification as read.

post.summary: Mark all notifications as read
post.description: Marks all unread notifications for the customer as read.

get.description: Retrieves customer full name, date of birth, NIC, phone number, email address, verification statuses, and primary branch.

post.summary: Request secondary contact verification OTP via Phone (SMSlenz.lk) or Email (Gmail API / SMTP)
post.description: Dispatches a 6-digit OTP to verify a new secondary phone number (via SMSlenz.lk https://smslenz.lk/api/send-sms) or secondary email address (via Gmail API OAuth2 or SMTP). Enforces rate-limiting and 5-minute expiry.

post.summary: Verify and activate secondary contact for login
post.description: Submits the OTP for the additional contact. Once verified, this contact is activated and can also be used for customer login.

post.summary: Request account closure authorization OTP via Phone (SMSlenz.lk) or Email (Gmail API / SMTP)
post.description: Dispatches a mandatory 6-digit security OTP to the customer's registered primary contact (via SMSlenz.lk SMS https://smslenz.lk/api/send-sms or Gmail API/SMTP) required to authorize permanent account closure.

post.summary: Confirm self-service account closure using OTP
post.description: Confirms soft closure of the customer account with fresh OTP verification. Marks status as Inactive, records CustomerRequestedClosure timestamp, revokes all active sessions/refresh tokens, and retains all financial, plan, and audit histories for regulatory compliance.

post.summary: Acknowledge and dismiss investment popup alert
post.description: Records customer acknowledgement and dismissal of an investment popup alert (Chitu raffle winner or Jewellery plan completion). Subsequent investment queries will return shouldShowPopup=false while retaining the alert for permanent banner display. Safe and idempotent on repeat calls. Customer ownership is strictly verified.

parameters.name: alertId
parameters.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the plan alert to acknowledge.

200.description: Alert successfully acknowledged. Returns the updated alert with shouldShowPopup=false.

401.description: Unauthorized. Missing or invalid Bearer access token.

403.description: Forbidden. The requested alert belongs to another customer.

404.description: Not Found. The specified alert ID does not exist.

alerts.description: All active alerts and banners for this Chitu investment plan.

winnerAlert.description: Raffle winner alert details if this slot won a round, or null if none.

completionAlert.description: Completion alert if target grams have been reached, or null if not yet completed.

alerts.description: All active alerts and permanent banners associated with this enrolment.

status.description: Payment status: Pending, Succeeded, Failed, Cancelled, PartiallyRefunded, Refunded, or RequiresReconciliation. RequiresReconciliation indicates payment collected by gateway but crediting exceeds plan remaining target, queued for branch reconciliation.

referenceId.description: Associated entity ID (e.g. Plan ID, Enrolment ID, Slot ID).

planAlertId.description: Direct link to PlanAlert entity if spawned by an alertable event.

status.description: Payment status: Pending, Succeeded, Failed, Cancelled, PartiallyRefunded, Refunded, or RequiresReconciliation. RequiresReconciliation indicates payment collected by gateway but crediting exceeds plan remaining target, queued for branch reconciliation.

alertId.description: Unique identifier of the plan alert.

eventType.description: Domain event type triggering the alert. Reconciles both JewelleryCompletion (canonical database type) and JewelleryPlanCompletion (alias).

title.description: Short headline for popup and banner headers.

message.description: Full user-facing congratulatory message including slot/round or target grams and branch details.

planName.description: Name of the associated savings or jewellery plan.

referenceId.description: Primary investment entity ID (PlanId for Chitu investment view, EnrolmentId for Jewellery enrolment view).

slotId.description: Specific Chitu slot ID that won the raffle (null for Jewellery).

slotDisplayCode.description: Formatted slot display code (e.g. "SLOT-004") (null for Jewellery).

roundIndex.description: Scheduled raffle round number won (null for Jewellery).

scheduledMonthYear.description: Scheduled draw period (e.g. "November 2026") derived from schedule rather than admin draw entry date.

redemptionType.description: Prize redemption modality: "Gold" or "Cash" (null for Jewellery).

prizeAmount.description: Authoritative prize money or gold value if specified on the round record.

enrolmentId.description: Specific Jewellery enrolment ID completed (null for Chitu).

targetGrams.description: Target gold grams achieved upon completion (null for Chitu).

branchName.description: Branch name where physical prize or jewellery can be collected.

outletAddress.description: Physical address of the collection outlet.

outletPhone.description: Contact phone of the collection outlet.

eventTimestampUtc.description: UTC timestamp when the winning round or jewellery completion was recorded.

acknowledgedAtUtc.description: UTC timestamp when customer acknowledged/dismissed the popup.

isAcknowledged.description: Whether customer has dismissed the popup alert.

shouldShowPopup.description: Indicates if the mobile client should trigger an immediate popup dialog (!IsAcknowledged).

collectionInstruction.description: Direct guidance on collecting the prize/jewellery in store.

alert.description: Updated alert entity showing IsAcknowledged = true and ShouldShowPopup = false.

Bearer.description: Enter your JWT Bearer token (e.g., Bearer eyJhbGci...)
